installCommand: mkdir -p /tmp/pnpm-bin && corepack enable pnpm --install-directory /tmp/pnpm-bin && PATH=/tmp/pnpm-bin:$PATH pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: mkdir -p /tmp/pnpm-bin && corepack enable pnpm --install-directory /tmp/pnpm-bin && cd ../.. && PATH=/tmp/pnpm-bin:$PATH pnpm turbo build --filter=test-studio
